items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Well I had an uncle, I still have an uncle, and he was playing drums.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about your family as much as you can remember about your parents? Did they play any musical instruments?
Well I had an uncle, I still have an uncle, and he was playing drums.
His name is Christopher Miner. Do you have his address or can you tell me?
